visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with glasses wearing a grey sweater and dark trousers bends over a table covered with a green cloth. He places a large red box on the table, followed by two stacked cardboard boxes featuring Mickey Mouse and Marvel illustrations. The room is brightly lit with white blinds in the background. (2) The camera moves to a close-up of the Mickey Mouse box and then the Marvel comic-style box. A hand enters the frame to point at the Marvel character illustrations. The background remains the same indoor setting. (3) The man opens a black carrying case with two white circles, resembling Mickey Mouse's trousers. He holds up a tray of white Mahjong tiles. The lighting is bright and even. (4) Detailed close-ups show the Mahjong tiles with various Disney characters and symbols, including Mickey, Pluto, and snowflakes. The man's hand interacts with the tiles, pointing at the designs. (5) Three acrylic rulers (red and black) are shown, featuring character silhouettes like Goofy and Minnie, along with signatures. The man peels a plastic film off one of the red rulers. (6) A round wind indicator and red dice with a 'thumbs up' Mickey hand icon are shown in a black foam insert. (7) A close-up reveals 'White' tiles with a rectangular frame design. The man's finger traces the frame on the tile. (8) A top-down shot displays the entire set: 'Bamboo' tiles are anchors, and 'Dot' tiles are Mickey Mouse heads in black and red. (9) The man sits at an automatic Mahjong table, wearing a watch. He attempts to identify tiles by touch, picking them up and showing them to the camera. Green table surface is visible.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a resonant thud as a heavy box is placed on a table, accompanied by an upbeat, high-tempo electronic BGM with a strong 4/4 beat. A male voice speaks with high energy and excitement, greeting the audience. (2) As the narrator describes the boxes, the BGM continues consistently. A soft rustling sound is heard as hands interact with cardboard. (3) A distinct mechanical click and a soft sliding sound occur as the Mahjong case is opened. The narrator's pitch rises when expressing affection for Mickey Mouse. (4) During the detailed description of the tiles, the BGM volume is slightly ducked to prioritize the clear, fast-paced narration. Subtle clinks of acrylic tiles hitting each other are heard. (5) A sharp peeling sound of plastic film being removed is clearly audible. The narrator continues at a high arousal level, pointing out signatures and characters. (6) A series of 'Ding-ding' and 'De-de' cartoonish SFX are introduced to signify correct and incorrect guesses during the blind-touch segment. The narrator's speech becomes even faster and more rhythmic, matching the playfulness of the game. The video ends with a triumphant 'Yeah!' and the BGM fading out.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Introduction -> Detailed Component Showcase -> Hands-on Demonstration -> Conclusion.
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves to promote and unbox a Disney-themed Mahjong set created by Beast Kingdom. It uses high-energy narration, fast-paced editing, and a playful 'guessing game' demonstration to highlight the unique design elements of the product, such as custom tile icons and character signatures, appealing to both Mahjong players and Disney fans.
